email-inbox-summary-generate.prompt:
IMPORTANT: Before generating any report, read and follow ALL rules in ${REPO_PERSONAL}/virtual-office/config/report-rules.md. This is the GENERATE sub-flow of the email-inbox-summary skill. It (1) re-scans all enabled Gmail mailboxes in advisory mode, (2) builds per-mailbox and cross-mailbox HTML reports, and (3) leaves a single index URL the user can click to triage. It performs NO mutations and NO summarize/trash/unsub actions -- those belong to the email-inbox-summary-execute job. All gmail-manager scripts already exist; do NOT duplicate their logic in this prompt -- just invoke them in order. STEP 1 (rescan, advisory mode). cd ${REPO_PERSONAL}/gmail-manager && python -m src --scan-all --reprocess. Capture the PST start timestamp at the very beginning of the job for the VO subtitle. STEP 2 (per-mailbox sender-volume reports). For each enabled mailbox id in ${REPO_PERSONAL}/gmail-manager/config/mailboxes.json (currently: primary-gmail, jqx2014-gmail, junshif16-gmail, oakley-wyoming-gmail -- do NOT hardcode this list, read mailboxes.json each run): python ${REPO_PERSONAL}/gmail-manager/scripts/build_sender_sorted.py --mailbox . This writes ${REPO_PERSONAL}/gmail-manager/output//senders-by-volume-YYYYMMDD.html with Unread / Read columns and an unread% bar per sender. STEP 3 (cross-mailbox inbox summary). python ${REPO_PERSONAL}/gmail-manager/scripts/build_cross_mailbox_summary.py. Writes ${REPO_PERSONAL}/gmail-manager/output/meta/inbox-summary-cross-mailbox-YYYYMMDD.html sorted by inbox count desc. STEP 4 (interactive triage forms). python ${REPO_PERSONAL}/gmail-manager/scripts/build_triage_form.py. Writes one triage-form-YYYYMMDD.html per mailbox (with action checkboxes: trash / trash_if_not_unread / unsub / block / keep / summarize / move_to_label / rename), plus a master triage-form-index-YYYYMMDD.html under output/meta/. STEP 5 (chat output). Print exactly one line to stdout (and the VO chat summary): 'Inbox summary ready: . Click each mailbox card to triage, tick boxes, press "Copy as JSON", paste back into chat to trigger email-inbox-summary-execute.' Also list the senders-by-volume / cross-mailbox URLs as secondary links. SUBMISSION PROTOCOL (for the user, document in chat output): the triage form's "Copy as JSON" button produces a JSON array. Each item has shape: {"mailbox": "", "sender": "", "from_email": "", "actions": ["", ...], "params": {}}. Valid actions: trash (move all matching messages to TRASH); trash_if_not_unread (trash only read messages); unsub (RFC 8058 one-click POST or HTTPS GET on List-Unsubscribe header); block (create users().settings().filters() that auto-trashes future mail from this from_email); keep (no-op, marker for "reviewed and kept"); summarize (fetch full bodies, extract plaintext, build Chinese per-line summary with bolded subject/sender/date/key dates/keywords/distilled meaning/body preview); move_to_label (params.label required, creates label if missing, handles 409 case-insensitive Gmail label conflicts); rename (params.new_name required, group label renaming). VO SUBTITLE: every HTML report written by this job MUST include

Agent: pEmailer | Job: email-inbox-summary-generate | Start: | Complete:

immediately under the main title. The build scripts already emit this from their START_TIME/end logic -- verify after the run, do not modify the build scripts. NO HTML REPORT FROM THIS JOB ITSELF: this job does NOT produce a VO-output report; its outputs are the gmail-manager HTML files above. The chat summary IS the VO output (saveOutput=true captures it).
email-inbox-summary-generate.description: GENERATE sub-flow of email-inbox-summary skill: rescan + build 9 HTMLs (4 senders-by-volume + 4 triage forms + 1 cross-mailbox summary + 1 form index)

email-inbox-summary-execute.prompt:
IMPORTANT: Before generating any report, read and follow ALL rules in ${REPO_PERSONAL}/virtual-office/config/report-rules.md. This is the EXECUTE sub-flow of the email-inbox-summary skill. It takes a JSON array of triage selections submitted by the user (copied from a triage-form-YYYYMMDD.html), validates it, and dispatches mutations against the appropriate Gmail mailboxes. Honor [[feedback_skip_html_when_no_summary]]: if NO item has a 'summarize' action, do NOT produce an HTML report -- write the JSON log and return a concise chat table only.

INPUT. The user submission is provided to this job in the ${USER_INPUT} env var as a JSON array, OR passed inline in the invocation prompt under a ```json fenced block. If neither is present, fail fast with: 'No submission JSON provided. Expected JSON array of {mailbox, sender, actions, params} items.' Submission schema (one item per sender, one or more actions per item, executed in fixed order summarize -> move_to_label -> unsub -> block -> trash):
  [
    {
      "mailbox": "jqx2014-gmail",
      "sender": "Rachel Hughes",
      "from_email": "rachel@example.com",
      "actions": ["summarize", "move_to_label"],
      "params": {"label": "receipt-medical-rachel"}
    }
  ]

VALID ACTIONS. trash | trash_if_not_unread | unsub | block | keep | summarize | move_to_label | rename. Action semantics match the email-inbox-summary-generate prompt (single source of truth there).

STEP 1 (group submission by mailbox). Split the input array into per-mailbox sub-batches. For each mailbox, load the most recent groups snapshot at ${REPO_PERSONAL}/gmail-manager/output/<mailbox>/digest-YYYYMMDD-groups.json (falling back to newest digest-*-groups.json if today's is absent).

STEP 2 (identity check, per mailbox, BEFORE any mutation). Per [[feedback_skip_html_when_no_summary]] sibling rule on cross-mailbox token contamination: call provider.service.users().getProfile(userId='me') and assert the emailAddress matches the 'email' field in ${REPO_PERSONAL}/gmail-manager/config/mailboxes.json for that mailbox id. If mismatch, ABORT the entire batch with an err-note in the report explaining the identity drift -- do NOT mutate.

STEP 3 (by-name matching, NOT by rank). Match each submitted item to a group via case-insensitive exact match on sender display name, with a substring fallback (see ${REPO_PERSONAL}/gmail-manager/scripts/execute_triage_jqx2014_round2_20260525.py find_group_by_name). If ANY submitted sender has no match (none + none after substring), abort the entire per-mailbox batch -- partial execution is forbidden.

STEP 4 (dispatch). For each matched item, run actions in this strict order: summarize -> move_to_label -> unsub -> block -> trash. Use the helpers from execute_triage_jqx2014_round2_20260525.py as reference: trash_messages_handling_stale (404 -> log as stale-id, continue, never abort); move_to_label_handling_stale (resolve_label_id with 409 case-insensitive fallback); fetch_full_or_404 + extract_plaintext + build_chinese_summary for summarize; provider.unsubscribe / RFC 8058 one-click for unsub; users().settings().filters().create() for block. All operations idempotent: already-trashed / already-labeled / already-blocked = silent no-op.

STEP 5 (Chinese summary format, per [[feedback_summary_format]]). When the summarize action runs, the per-message card body must use ONE FIELD PER LINE with bolded value labels: 主题 (subject), 发件人 (sender + email), 日期 (date), 关键日期 (extracted dates), 关键词 (keywords / amounts / confirmation numbers), 提炼意思 (distilled meaning -- what this email is actually telling the user), 正文片段 (body preview, ~200 chars). Do NOT pack multiple fields onto one line. The build_chinese_summary helper in execute_triage_jqx2014_round2_20260525.py is the closest reference -- adopt its per-line layout and extend with the 提炼意思 / 正文片段 lines.

STEP 6 (outputs).
  (a) Always write a JSON log to ${REPO_PERSONAL}/gmail-manager/output/<mailbox>/triage-execution-<runid>.json with: submission, match_log, results, labels, summaries, stale_ids, pre_inbox, post_inbox, identity_check, start, end.
  (b) If ANY item has a 'summarize' action AND produced >=1 summary card: write a Stripe-styled HTML report at ${REPO_PERSONAL}/gmail-manager/output/<mailbox>/triage-execution-<runid>.html. VO subtitle: Agent: pEmailer | Job: email-inbox-summary-execute | Start: <PST start> | Complete: <PST now>. Open it in Edge via ${REPO_PERSONAL}/virtual-office/runner/open-in-edge.py (if available) or 'Start-Process msedge <path>'.
  (c) If summarize was in the submission but produced 0 cards (all 404 stale or no read+unread match): still write HTML so user sees the '0 results' verification, mark it clearly in the title.
  (d) If NO summarize action was in the submission: DO NOT write HTML. Per-mailbox JSON log only.

STEP 7 (refresh). After execution completes (success or per-mailbox abort), run python -m src --scan-all --reprocess from ${REPO_PERSONAL}/gmail-manager to refresh the digest snapshots for the next round. This is best-effort -- do not fail the job if rescan errors.

STEP 8 (chat summary). Print a per-item result table (mailbox | sender | actions | summarized | moved | trashed | stale | notes) to stdout. List paths of any HTML reports written. List path of every JSON log written.

HARD RULES. Never modify gmail-manager source code from this job. Never re-create Gmail filters or labels that already exist (idempotent). Never abort mid-batch on a 404 (treat as stale-id and continue). Never proceed past identity-check failure. Never produce HTML when no summary content exists (per [[feedback_skip_html_when_no_summary]]). Stay in coordinator-style dispatch -- run the scripts, parse results, report; do not invent new mutation paths.
email-inbox-summary-execute.description: EXECUTE sub-flow of email-inbox-summary skill: takes user JSON triage submission, runs identity check + by-name matching + idempotent mutations, refreshes digest, returns per-item chat table

MSFT-email.description: MSFT (Outlook/M365) inbox triage via WorkIQ MCP (Microsoft Graph): categorize, delete noise, block spam to Junk, mark important, filter to M/z-Notifications folders, generate HTML report. Portable across New Outlook (olk), classic Outlook COM, and OWA. Successor to msft-outlook-email-inbox-clean.
MSFT-email.prompt:
Run the MSFT-email inbox-clean workflow defined in ${REPO_PERSONAL}/virtual-office/skills/MSFT-email.md. PRIMARY execution path = WorkIQ MCP (Microsoft 365 Graph); it works regardless of desktop Outlook flavor (New Outlook 'olk', classic Outlook COM, OWA). Only fall back to classic-Outlook COM (scripts/outlook/Generate-InboxReport.ps1 under Windows PowerShell 5.1) when a classic MAPI profile exists and MCP is unavailable.

PHASE 1 CATEGORIZE (read-only): GET /me/mailFolders/inbox/messages?$select=subject,from,importance,receivedDateTime,isRead&$orderby=receivedDateTime desc&$top=25. WorkIQ rejects $skip -- page with a cursor $filter=receivedDateTime lt <receivedDateTime-of-last-item>; 25/collection cap. Meeting invite = @odata.type #microsoft.graph.eventMessageRequest; cancel = #microsoft.graph.eventMessage with subject starting 'Canceled:'; forward = subject starting 'Meeting Forward Notification:'; external = subject contains [EXTERNAL] (case-insensitive).

PHASE 2 DELETE (workiq delete_entity /me/messages/{id}; goes to Deleted Items, recoverable): Office 365/SharePoint, Power BI, Lockbox, meeting invites+cancellations+forwards (delete ALL meeting-schedule mail -- the meeting is already on the calendar so the email is redundant; unattended, no review gate), automatic replies (Automatic reply:/Out of Office:), Azure User Access Review, Event Polls.

PHASE 3 BLOCK to Junk (do_action /me/mailFolders/inbox/messages/{id}/move jsonBody {"destinationId":"junkemail"}): Chatsworth, IBC, Emerson, and unsolicited external-DOMAIN marketing/recruiting (non-microsoft.com/skype.net cold outreach) except Fidelity. Do NOT junk by the [EXTERNAL] subject tag -- it also rides on internal replies and genuine external work/personal mail; skip borderline work/personal senders.

PHASE 4 MARK IMPORTANT (update_entity /me/messages/{id} jsonBody {"importance":"high"} -- payload param is jsonBody NOT body; skip items already high): Madhu Sudan, Zoran Cvetkovic, Vivek Mohan.

PHASE 5 FILTER via move to M/z-Notifications subfolders (resolve ids by name: /me/mailFolders -> M -> childFolders z-Notifications -> childFolders target): FreeFood DL + Tiffany Smit -> Food; CMD Automation + gautosa\d+@microsoft.com + Global Regulation/Weekly Feed -> TeamsNotification; Azure Access Review (if kept) -> 0-ActionNeeded.

PHASE 6-7 REPORT: build the dark-theme foldable HTML (Meetings future->past with dynamic NOW line + tabs, External, Regular grouped by sender) to ~/inbox_report.html with VO subtitle 'Agent: pEmailer | Job: MSFT-email | Start: <PST> | Complete: <PST>'; open via Start-Process msedge --disable-extensions --new-tab file:///C:/Users/qitxu/inbox_report.html. Print a summary table of actions taken.
